items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: My name is Moose Zanko.

ctx.x: Thank you for calling. Let's talk it over this morning. We'll have to do this again real soon. 523-2404 is the number to call to talk it over with a man who knows the answers to the questions, Mr. Dick Allen from Tulane University. He's with the library, and in particular with the jazz archives at the library, and one of the greats, all-time greats of the city, and not only the city but known worldwide, Mr. Johnny Wiggs of Johnny Wiggs and the New Orleans Kings. Good morning. You're on the air.
Good morning, Joe. My name is Moose Zanko.
